data.title: ‘In perfect condition’ – Lamine Yamal ready to play ‘90 minutes’ against England - Yahoo Sports
data.content: # ‘In perfect condition’ – Lamine Yamal ready to play ‘90 minutes’ against England. Spain boss Luis de la Fuente says Lamine Yamal is in "perfect condition" and ready to play the whole game against England in the Nations League on Sunday. Yamal missed Spain's first game of the break with Czechia due to a knee issue but will now link up with the squad for their second match against the Three Lions. Speaking after the win over Czechia, De la Fuente offered a brief update on Yamal's progress, per Mundo Deportivo. Lamine Yamal is feeling much better and is eager to join the training camp tomorrow. One will arrive around midday and the other a little later, but both will be with us tomorrow," he said. He went on to add that the two players "are ready to play 90 minutes" and "in perfect condition.". Barcelona will no doubt be keeping a close eye on the situation and hoping that no risks are taken with Yamal.

data.title: Injured Yamal to miss Spain's Nations League game against the Czechs but is expected to face England - FOX Sports
data.content: # Injured Yamal to miss Spain's Nations League game against the Czechs but is expected to face England. MADRID (AP) — Lamine Yamal will miss Spain's Nations League game against the Czech Republic on Thursday because of a knee issue but is expected to be available for the match against England on Sunday. The Spanish federation said Monday that Yamal will join the team’s training camp late after the forward reported discomfort in his right knee following Barcelona's game against Atletico Madrid in the Spanish league on Sunday. After medical tests, it was decided that Yamal would continue his recovery in Barcelona instead of traveling to Madrid to join the national team. The federation said the 19-year-old Yamal would go to the training camp “in the coming days” and was expected to be available for Sunday's match against England at Atletico's Metropolitano Stadium. Yamal had an assist in Barcelona's 2-1 win at Atletico, which left the Catalan club three points ahead of second-place Real Madrid after 12 rounds.
